newsitem.title: USA: Bio-Vascular gets FDA Peri-Strip clearance.
newsitem.headline: Bio-Vascular gets FDA Peri-Strip clearance.

text.p: Bio-Vascular Inc said Tuesday it received 510(k) marketing clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its Peri-Strips Dry product.
Peri-Strips are used to reinforce the surgical staple-line and prevent leakage of air during and after lung volume reduction surgery for treatment of late-stage emphysema.
Bio-Vascular said it expects to launch Peri-Strips Dry in July.
The company said it filed its application with the FDA on March 20 and received on Tuesday the letter granting marketing clearance.
Bio-Vascular said it expects the Peri-Strips Dry to go over especially well in Europe because of the type of surgery usually done. It submitted its application for European clearance on May 2.

"Reaction from the surgical community has been very enthusiastic, and more importantly, the results from the first European surgeries using Peri-Strips Dry confirmed the significant benefits of this new version," Bio-Vascular president and chief executive John Karcanes said.
